newsitem.title: USA: Resource America stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Resource America stake held by group.

text.p: A group led by Bay Pond partners L.P. said Wednesday it holds 240,000 class A common shares of Resource America Inc, representing 6.76 percent of the class outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the shares Nov 11 at $13.00 to $15.0260 a share.
The group holds the stake for investment.
Bay Pond is a Boston-based investment partnership.
Resource America, based in Philadelphia, is a real-estate mortgage and equipment-lease financing company.
